correctness.rationale: Each failed uniform B draw creates exactly one independent uniform A draw, regardless of whether the A draw settles a particle. This yields independent geometric repeat blocks and the exact product CDF; two independent analytic limit arguments prove the fixed-a Rayleigh law and the growing-a Gumbel law. The count TV bound follows from geometric-to-Bernoulli truncation and Bernoulli-to-Poisson coupling. The extracted exact-arithmetic checker passed 1516 assertions for all a=2..8 and b=1..16, supporting but not replacing infinite arguments.

value.rationale: The source-side occupancy time is a natural class-specific growth statistic on \(K_{a,b}\); the exact rational finite-size law, independent Rayleigh first-discovery times, uniform rare-event count bound and growing-side Gumbel threshold reveal a nontrivial collision-clock transition.
